editorial.description_en: Fern in full growth and full shade — the strongest true green in the corpus.
editorial.description_ja: 茂った羊歯のような、濃い緑。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.500, C 0.078, h 140.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 深 (fuka, deep) + 羊歯 (shida, fern). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Deep Fern" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 深羊歯. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — iwa-goke at ΔE00 6.6, yama-kage at ΔE00 6.6, rin-sho at ΔE00 9.0. complementary is empty because no entry in this corpus sits within 22° of the opposite hue. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
